items.title: Bitcoin firm Nakamoto owes Kraken $165 million, more than its entire market value
items.snippet: About 70% of the bitcoin treasury firm’s coins are pledged to the exchange, bought at roughly $118,000 each, and bitcoin now trades under $69,000.

items.title: Bitcoin slides below $70K amid thin liquidity, ETF outflows
items.snippet: Bitcoin fell below $70,000 as crypto sentiment hit its lowest level in more than four months, with analysts warning of institutional outflows, thinning liquidity and elevated leverage.

items.snippet: Recent rapid redemptions explain the market swoon. Bitcoin's spot price fell below $70,000 on Friday, the lowest since August.
